Shoplinker order collection

API for displaying the Shoplinker order list

get https://apiweb.shoplinker.co.kr/ShoplinkerApi/Order/orderlist.php?iteminfo_url=XML_URL[URL-encoded]

Request Parameters

No. Parameter Type Description Value range Remarks
1. Required customer_id string Customer code (Shoplinker registration code) Code issued by Shoplinker
ex) a0000001
2. Required shoplinker_id string Shoplinker account
3. order_flag string Order type Allowed values
  1. - Normal orders [new OR purchase order] : 000
  2. - Purchase-order-confirmed orders : 007
  3. - New orders : 001
  4. - Settlement-confirmed orders : 002
  5. - Orders with registered waybills : 003
  6. - Waybill transmission completed :004
 If no value is supplied, normal orders are shown.
* When the order type is normal order (000), new orders are first changed to purchase-order-confirmed status, then the final confirmed orders are retrieved. (New orders + purchase-order-confirmed orders)
4. Required st_date string Order start date yyyymmdd Based on the date the order was first registered in Shoplinker.
5. Required ed_date string Order end date yyyymmdd Based on the date the order was first registered in Shoplinker.
6. sdt_time string Order start date and time hhiiss Query start time
7. edt_time string Order end date and time hhiiss Query end time
8. mall_order_code string Shoplinker marketplace code Allowed values
  1. - Collect all : no code
  2. - Collect open marketplace orders only : APISHOP_O-001
  3. - Collect social commerce orders only : APISHOP_S-001
  4. - General and specialist marketplaces : APISHOP_H-001
  5. - Collect by marketplace :
* Enter this code accurately. If the marketplace is not listed, add it in the marketplace setup. ex )APISHOP_0001
9. mall_user_id string Marketplace account EX) Auction login ID -a123
10. page_no string Page number Specify the page number when there are more than 500 orders
11. total_standard_count string Total items displayed per page The default is 500 records
12. supply_id string Supplier ID

APIThe script tag that loads it can be placed in the HTML file's head, body or elsewhere in the file. However, it must be declared before the execution code. 

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="euc-kr"?>
<Shoplinker>
	<OrderInfo>
		<Order>
			<customer_id>a1234567</customer_id>
			<shoplinker_id><![CDATA[abded]]></shoplinker_id>
			<st_date>20160401</st_date>
			<ed_date>20160404</ed_date>
			<mall_order_code>APISHOP_0010</mall_order_code>
			<mall_user_id><![CDATA[abc]]></mall_user_id>
			<page_no>1</page_no>
			<total_standard_count>10</total_standard_count>
			<supply_id><![CDATA[p000000]]></supply_id>
		</Order>
	</OrderInfo>
</Shoplinker>

Response

No. Parameter Type Description Value range Remarks
1. shoplinker_order_id string Shoplinker order number
2. mall_order_id string Marketplace order number
3. mall_name string Marketplace name
4. baesong_status string Delivery status [purchase order confirmed]
5. order_name string Buyer name
6. order_tel string Buyer phone number
7. order_cel string Buyer mobile number
8. order_email string Buyer email address
9. receive string Recipient name
10. receive_tel string Recipient phone number
11. receive_cel string Recipient mobile number
12. receive_zipcode string Recipient postal code
13. receive_addr string Recipient address
14. baesong_type string Shipping fee payment method [free shipping, freight collect, collect freight paid in advance]
15. baesong_bi string Shipping fee
16. delivery_msg string Delivery message Store pickup or overseas orders are shown in msg. ex: Customer request...[Store pickup] or overseas delivery order
17. order_product_id string Ordered product number
18. shoplinker_product_id string Shoplinker product number
19. partner_product_id string Your own product code
20. product_name string Product name
21. quantity string Order quantity
22. order_price string Order amount
23. sale_price string Unit sale price
24. supply_price string Supply price Amount formats differ by marketplace: ESM, 11st, and Store Farm use the expected settlement amount; other marketplaces use the delivery price or supply price.
25. sku string Option name Combination of required and additional options
26. orderdate string Order date
27. order_reg_date string Order collection date
28. delivery_invoice string Waybill number
29. order_seq string Combined order number Shown only for Auction, Gmarket, Smart Store, and CJ Home Shopping.
30. total_count string Total order count Located in the header tag
31. total_page string Total page count Located in the header tag
32. total_standard_count string Total items displayed per page Located in the header tag
33. currently_page string Page number requested by the current call Located in the header tag
34. currently_count string Number of orders returned by the current call header location
35. seller_id string Marketplace account
36. only_sku string Required option
37. add_sku string Additional options
38. mall_id string Shoplinker marketplace code Marketplace code managed by Shoplinker
ex) APISHOP_0003 : Auction code
39. dis_price_mall string Marketplace-funded discount amount Can be collected only for Interpark
40. dis_price_seller string Seller-funded discount amount Applies to open marketplaces (Interpark, Gmarket, Auction, Store Farm, Smart Store) and Godo Mall
41. dis_price_coupon string Coupon discount amount Applies to open marketplaces (Interpark, Gmarket, Auction, Store Farm, Smart Store) and Godo Mall
42. dis_price_point string Points discount amount Applies to open marketplaces (Interpark, Gmarket, Auction, Store Farm, Smart Store) and Godo Mall
43. distribution_delivery string Whether this is logistics delivery Allowed values
  1. - 001 : Standard delivery
  2. - 002 : Logistics delivery
 Shown only for Auction, Gmarket, and Smart Store
44. sku_match_code string Option matching code The option management code is shown when the product configuration contains option matching information.
45. sku_barcode string Option barcode The barcode is shown when the product configuration contains option matching information.
46. order_customs_number string Personal customs clearance code
47. order_input_type string Order form type Allowed values
  1. - 001 : Automatically collected orders
  2. - 002 : Manually collected orders
48. supply_id string Supplier ID
49. delivery string Carrier code
50. order_user_id string Buyer account
51. crspik_use string Crosspick order Shown for Lotte.com only
52. ship_no string Delivery number For Smart Store, the Smart Store order number is shown
53. deal_no string Deal number Shown only for WeMakePrice and TMON
54. exchange_order_yn string Whether an exchange request has been received Allowed values
  1. - Y : Exchange-request orders
55. order_main_key string Additional products (Interpark, 11st)
56. pan_type string Naver Pay payment method
57. channel_type string Channel type Order detail channel information
ex) If mall_id is Lotte Department Store - Lotte.com, Lotte iMall, Newell Lotte
      If mall_id is CJ Mall, the mobile, broadcast, or other channel is shown
58. ship_rsv_date string Scheduled delivery date Available only for certain marketplaces, including Interpark, Hyundai Home Shopping, CJ Home Shopping, and Lotte iMall.
59. delivery_attribute_type string Delivery attributes For Smart Store, delivery attributes are shown (Naver guaranteed arrival, seller guaranteed arrival, ships today)
For Auction and Gmarket, fulfillment Star Delivery and seller Star Delivery are shown
For MUSINSA Store, fulfillment (MFS) is shown
